# vibeoncall_member (Data Source)

Looks up a member of the organization by email. Members are invited or provisioned outside Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vibeoncall_member" "ada" {
  email = "ada@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address of the member. Matched exactly, ignoring case.

### Read-Only

- `full_name` (String) Full name of the member.
- `id` (String) Numeric user ID, referenced as `user_id` by team memberships.
- `status` (String) Account status in the organization: `active`, `pending`, or `revoked`.
